review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD and Gold agree on repository identity/base commit, paired case, stable REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 keys, the nine inspection owners, blocked readiness, and the requirement-decision-pending reason naming DEC-001. DEC-001 is material and explicitly unresolved: B must stop at decisions after repository and requirements evidence, without choosing a default or generating assignable tasks. Empty task and assignment expectations are therefore appropriate. The supplied policy places this gate before Scenario Coverage, so the empty team catalog and absent independent project reviewer do not introduce a required earlier blocker. Source evidence supports the message-formatting, normalization, snapshot, inheritance, and fetch-filtering ownership boundaries. Forwarding and declaration consumers require inspection, not mandatory edits; generated distribution declarations are not separately maintained owners under the supplied build configuration. The configured test pipeline distinguishes runtime tests from compile-time checks and includes the proposed test-d path. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. These are accepted as Service-calculated bindings, not independently recomputed hashes. The historical originalSpecification preparation fields do not override the supplied frozen release input. No candidate was supplied or evaluated, no code was executed, and no human decision or attestation is inferred; any fixed hypothetical C input would not resolve B's DEC-001. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was identified in this Gold.
